Interface Command

All Known Subinterfaces:
ElementCreationCommand, MacroCommand
All Known Implementing Classes:
AddElement, AddSupport, ApplyOperator, CreateAbstractSupport, CreateConclusion, CreateEvidence, CreateJustification, CreateStrategy, CreateSubConclusion, CreateTemplate, ImplementsTemplate, MarkUnified, OverrideAbstractSupport, RecordComposition, RegisterAlias, RegularCommand, RemoveElement, RewireStrategySupport
public interface Command
A command in the command pattern for model construction.

  • Method Details

    • condition

      default Predicate<Unit> condition()

    • ready

      default boolean ready(Unit unit, PendingCommands pending)
      Whether this command can run now. By default, when its condition() holds on the unit. A command whose outcome depends on a model being complete also waits until no pending command still targets that model, so that the meaning of a source does not depend on the order of its declarations (#177).
      Parameters:
      unit - the unit built so far.
      pending - the commands still waiting, this one excluded.

    • runWhenStuck

      default boolean runWhenStuck(Unit unit, PendingCommands pending)
      Whether this command may still run once nothing in the queue is ready, every command waiting on another. The engine then runs, best effort, one that may, so that one mistake does not hold back everything waiting on it: the first that reads no model another of them may still change, or else the first. By default, when its condition() holds: what it needs exists, complete or not. A command that must never act on an incomplete model refuses.

    • reads

      default Set<String> reads()
      The models this command reads, beyond the one it targets. When nothing is ready, the engine runs what may still change a model before a command that reads it, so that a reader acting on an incomplete model gets as much of it as its mistakes allow.

    • target

      default Optional<String> target()
      The model this command creates or changes, if any. Other commands read it to wait until a model is complete.

    • execute

      void execute(Unit context)

    • breaksItsTarget

      default boolean breaksItsTarget()
      Whether this command failing, or never running, leaves the model it targets unusable: nothing may consume it, and what else waits in it is no separate mistake, since the cause is reported where it is (#183). True of what gives a model its structure, an implements or an operator call; by default false, the model still being checked.

    • recordFailure

      default void recordFailure(Unit unit)
      Records in unit what this command failing leaves behind, so that the checkers do not report it again as the gaps it leaves (#183). By default, the target is marked incomplete when this command breaks it, and nothing otherwise.

    • withNamespace

      Command withNamespace(String ns)
      This command, read from a file loaded under namespace ns: every model name it holds is qualified by ns, and every qualified element id too (see QualifiedIds.inNamespace(String, String)); a plain element id, a label or a type is unchanged. Each command type states how it is namespaced, so that none escapes the namespace silently. A command the compiler creates while building the unit is never read from a file, and refuses.
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - if this command is never read from a file

    • declares

      default Optional<String> declares()
      The model this command declares, if it starts a model's declaration: a justification, a template, or the result of an operator call.

    • location

      default SourceLocation location()
      Where the statement this command comes from is written, so that a failure of the command is reported there. Commands created by the compiler rather than read from a source, such as the expansion of a macro, have none.
      Returns:
      the location, or SourceLocation.UNKNOWN.
